name: Optical Addressing of Photochromic Mixtures
aliases: Optical Addressing of Multi-Colour Photochromic Material Mixture
definition: A volumetric display technique that achieves position-selective colour transformation by controlling the arrival timing and irradiation durations of UV and visible (Vis) light, and colour-selective transformation by controlling the Vis irradiation spectra to decolour specific photochromic molecules (PMs) in a mixture.
